domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, manager decision, and potential cancellation.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — employee is composing the request; not yet visible to manager
SUBMITTED — employee has submitted; awaiting manager action
APPROVED — manager has approved; leave balance has been deducted
REJECTED — manager has rejected; terminal state, balance unaffected
CANCELLED — employee cancelled an approved leave; balance restored

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Each policy governs how many days employees receive, whether manager approval is required, and any notice-period constraints.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect and governs new leave requests
INACTIVE — policy is disabled; does not apply to new requests but historical references remain valid

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organization. Tracks employment lifecycle and reporting hierarchy (managerId). Employment status gates leave eligibility.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — employee is currently employed and eligible for leave
INACTIVE — employee is on extended absence (e.g. sabbatical); leave accrual may be paused
TERMINATED — employment has ended; no new leave requests allowed, balances are frozen

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and remaining balance for a specific leave policy within a fiscal year. Deducted on approval; restored on cancellation.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is in effect for the current fiscal year; used for leave validation
EXHAUSTED — remainingDays is zero; no further leave of this type can be taken
FROZEN — employee is terminated/inactive; balance preserved for audit but not usable

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type maps to a LeavePolicy that defines its rules. The feature scope covers annual, sick, and emergency; unpaid, maternity, and paternity are defined for completeness.

business_rules: BR-001 — Leave Balance Sufficiency: Before a LeaveRequest transitions to APPROVED, the employee's LeaveBalance.remainingDays for the corresponding policy must be >= the number of calendar days between startDate and endDate (inclusive). If insufficient, the request must be REJECTED.

BR-002 — Manager Approval Gate: If the LeavePolicy.requiresManagerApproval is true, a LeaveRequest in SUBMITTED state can only transition to APPROVED or REJECTED by the employee's manager (Employee.managerId). If the employee has no manager (managerId is null), the request is auto-approved (skip to APPROVED).

BR-003 — Minimum Notice Period: For leave types where LeavePolicy.minimumNoticeDays is set, the difference in calendar days between the submission date and LeaveRequest.startDate must be >= minimumNoticeDays. Violation blocks transition from DRAFT to SUBMITTED.
BR-004 — No Retroactive Leave: LeaveRequest.startDate must be >= the date of submission (today). Retroactive leave applications are not permitted.
BR-005 — Date Range Validity: LeaveRequest.endDate must be >= LeaveRequest.startDate. A leave request cannot have a negative or zero-day duration.

BR-006 — Balance Deduction on Approval: When a LeaveRequest transitions to APPROVED, the system MUST atomically increment LeaveBalance.usedDays by the leave duration and decrement remainingDays accordingly. This is a transactional boundary.

BR-007 — Balance Restoration on Cancellation: When an APPROVED LeaveRequest transitions to CANCELLED, the system MUST atomically decrement LeaveBalance.usedDays by the leave duration and increment remainingDays accordingly. This is a transactional boundary.
